SYMPTOM: Psychiatrist cited appetite suppression as reason not to prescribe bupropion.
CAUSE: High-functioning presentation bias — articulate patient filed under 'fine'; doctor recommended psychotherapy instead.
FIX: Rebuttal for next visit: 'I already have reduced appetite. When I took modafinil — same dopaminergic mechanism — my appetite and food pleasure actually INCREASED. Raising the dopamine floor is the fix, not the side effect.'
PREVENT: Lead with anhedonia only (not ADHD). Say: 'I have persistent anhedonia, lifelong pattern, everything costs disproportionate effort. I want to try Elontril specifically.' Keep it short. The modafinil response is the diagnostic trump card — one dose, dramatic improvement, wore off completely by morning.
